data.title: Hugging Face CEO says AI companies should be required to disclose hacks after OpenAI breach
data.description: Clem Delangue said that preventing releases of powerful AI models is not the way to stop attacks like the OpenAI hack on Hugging Face.
data.keywords: Hugging Face, Clem Delangue, Delangue, open-source model, model companies, cyber attacks, unreleased models, security breach
